title: Inferring Cooperativity From Pooled Measurements
summary: In many modern experiments, latent interactions drive multicomponent stochastic systems, yet the data are available only as pooled measurements that obscure these dependencies. Whether such interactions can be identified and inferred from aggregate signals remains largely unexplored. Motivated by multi-channel electrophysiological recordings, we address this problem by introducing sum-dependent Markov chains, a class of finite-state continuous-time multivariate Markov processes whose transition rates encode interactions through the aggregate state.
